JHRT 185 · Team Reveal — Film Two

The Ultimate Fashion Show

The 12 hero frames of the film — one per beat, every member on the same runway. Gold labels are the on-screen designer captions that appear as each member struts.

This is the storyboard, not the film yet. Nothing is animated. Approve these frames (or flag any face / scene to redo) and I'll animate each into a ~4-sec clip, add the captions + music, and stitch the ~50-sec movie. A couple I already know I can push further in the edit — e.g. Sagar’s face is hidden mid-flip, so his clip will open on his face before the flip.
